base: Create ONE portrait full-bleed ancient Egyptian RPG Maker/tsukuru game map concept map14 'Pyramid central burial chamber'. References are mandatory ART STYLE and aged masonry authority only: clean painted pixel clusters, varied material-colored contours, warm cream/honey sandstone, peach muted midtones, deep umber shadow, worn large blocks. Do not copy reference layout, mural gallery, stairs or furnishings. Portrait about2:3, high3/4 overhead game floor camera, roof omitted, no horizon, no cinematic vanishing point, no floating isometric island. An ANCIENT quiet monumental burial interior, NOT refurbished palace. Tall massive worn walls, irregular-depth niches, restrained faded lapis pigment and small aged bronze accents, no white polished columns, red trim, gold treasure piles, neon or purple filters. BOTTOM broad return entry to13 fully visible, generous threshold and landing, walkable central area. UPPER area features ONE large CLOSED stone royal sarcophagus resting on low fixed platform, heavy lid and subdued incised face/royal relief, NO ANKH or loop-topped cross anywhere. Behind sarcophagus an imposing fixed stone wall panel with unmarked inset mounting area for later seal overlay. No need to open/destroy coffin. Low CENTRAL fixed stone pedestal/plinth with EMPTY top for later movable glyph mechanism, enough floor on all sides to circle it and inspect wall. ONE accessible deep SIDE WALL reward niche at standing height, EMPTY finished interior and fixed frame, no treasure, no door/lid baked in. More architectural shallow niches may exist but no confusion with extra reward chests. All changing glyph faces, seal marks, niche covers, artifact and activation effects omitted from fixed background and added later as separate assets. No solved puzzle sequence, random glyph text, mirrors, beams, pressure plates, laser devices or new puzzle mechanics. Preserve wide return route even after reward. Blank stone supports are intentionally ready for separate gameplay parts, not missing texture. Large worn floor slabs, limited damage and sand in corners, no rubble blocking route. Dim warm indirect ambient light keeps sarcophagus and every walking surface readable; shadows deeper in niches and upper rear wall. Distinct warm material planes not flat brown wash. No living characters, text, labels, coordinates, UI or annotations. ONE complete standalone map, no collage.
